answer: An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the summit index resolves every citation against the dune checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the spiral audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 81 aliases thus pays the authoring cost 81 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. That is 38 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
